calls.raw: Decision: Implement verbosity settings in submodule rebase. This aligns with P.1.1 as it addresses the oversight noted in handling submodule changes.

Decision: Implement -p with offset delta calculation for edited patches. This improves patch handling without needing '--recount' or '--allow-overlap'. As per P.1.2, recounting lines helps adjust offsets for subsequent hunks. Supports P.1.2 for practical improvements.
